input.description: Telemetry over 4 hours shows cabin_temp_c steadily climbing from 2.0°C to 5.6°C while controller_reading_c stays flat at ~2.0°C (tracking setpoint), and compressor_current_a declining from 11.5A to 8.2A as the controller throttles cooling believing setpoint is met. This exactly matches KB-003: controller sensor calibration drift causing under-cooling while its own return-air reading still reports setpoint. KB-003 notes the alternate scenario (controller reading tracking the cabin probe, indicating a refrigeration circuit fault needing a technician) does not apply here, since the two readings have clearly diverged. No conflicting KB entries were found for this symptom, and service history is empty. Recommended fix: send_diagnostic_reset to re-run controller self-calibration.
